name: edge-blocked-mixed
description: Clean site whose robots.txt disallows only GPTBot, while the edge returns 403 to all three probe tokens. GPTBot is policy (not probed); OAI-SearchBot and Claude-User are allowed by robots.txt and refused by the edge, which is the real defect: critical cr.access.edge_block for the two citation-tier agents, with GPTBot listed as policy in the evidence.

expected.notes: Proves the robots filter is per token, not all-or-nothing. cr.access.edge_block_training passes because GPTBot was never probed: its refusal is the site's policy, reported as the cr.robots.training_bot_blocked note.
